style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 3ft Pre-Lit Faux Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Add a festive touch to even the smallest of spaces with our Luxury 3ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree. Featuring snow-dusted green branches and sat nestled in a hessian-style bag, this thoughtfully designed piece has a compact base, making it the perfect fit for tabletops, sideboards and entryways. Warm white plug-in LED lights are pre-fitted throughout, casting a soft, ambient glow that brings instant warmth and cheer.<br><br>Ideal for adding festive flair to any corner of your home, with no assembly required, this piece is a stylish favourite you'll enjoy for seasons to come.<br><br>• COMPACT &amp; STYLISH DESIGN: Measuring 92cm tall, this small frosted Christmas tree is perfect for tabletops, sideboards, desks, and entryways – ideal for adding festive charm to smaller spaces without overwhelming the room.<br>• PRE-LIT WITH WARM WHITE LEDS: Fitted with warm white plug-in LED lights, this tree delivers a soft, ambient glow – ideal for creating a cosy and inviting festive atmosphere with no need for separate lighting.<br>• FROSTED REALISTIC BRANCHES: Designed with lifelike green branches dusted in artificial snow, this tree captures the look and feel of a classic winter scene – perfect for adding a touch of seasonal magic to your home.<br>• READY TO DISPLAY: Nestled in a hessian-style sack base for a natural, handcrafted look, this tree arrives pre-assembled and ready to enjoy straight from the box – no setup required.<br>• FESTIVE FAVOURITE: Designed for indoor use, this mini tree is a convenient and charming seasonal accent you’ll look forward to displaying year after year.<br><br>• Dimensions:<br>&nbsp; • Tree height: 92cm<br>&nbsp; • Tree width: 76cm<br>&nbsp; • Base height: 10cm<br>• Weight: 2.5kg<br>• Cable length: 90cm<br>• Tips: 584<br><br>Additional Information:<br>Battery operated, requires 3 x AA batteries (batteries are not included)
